truth_evidence: Affected every release before 3.1.3; fixed in 3.1.3 (keys with spaces passed to xmlattr inject attributes).
Fix commit 716795, the merge of the GHSA-h5c8-rqwp-cp95 advisory PR, in tag 3.1.3 and not in 3.1.2. https://github.com/pallets/jinja/commit/716795349a41d4983a9a4771f7d883c96ea17be7
do_xmlattr: the join-comprehension becomes a loop that raises ValueError when _space_re matches a key.
Added, not vulnerable: the module-level _space_re regex.

This function is a template filter. Templates reach it through the filter table (jinja2.filters.FILTERS), not through a Python call, so a project that uses the filter in a template has no Python call to it. Python-level call analysis cannot see template usage; the scan side must not report not_found on the strength of Python calls alone for filter advisories.
